$comment: TransLink routes shown on the map. Matched against GTFS routes.txt by name (never route_id, which changes between feeds). 'kind' drives how vehicles are modelled: 'skytrain' = track-level (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#track-graph–4.4), 'shape' = interpolated along GTFS shapes, 'bus' = GTFS-RT with schedule fallback. 'kinematics' overrides the vehicle settings of the route's mode (config/defaults/kinematics.json, then its operator's). 'color' is optional; when omitted the GTFS route_color is used. GTFS has no colours for buses, so each gets a distinct colour for legibility. 'category' is the layer the route belongs to in the site's layers panel: 'rapid' (dedicated right of way: SkyTrain, SeaBus, West Coast Express), 'frequent' (the 99 B-Line and RapidBus R1–R6: frequent, but not true BRT, without dedicated right of way) or 'regular' (every other bus: the feed's other bus routes, listed on cards from the plan's catalogue but not drawn). Set by hand for now (the user's call, 2026-10-14); 'frequent' vs 'regular' should later be computed from scheduled frequency when the plan is built.
